title: Dolbeault-Dirac operators on compact Kähler manifolds in Banach noncommutative geometry
summary: We develop an $\mathrm{L}^p$-theory for Dolbeault-Dirac operators on compact Kähler manifolds with coefficients in a Hermitian holomorphic vector bundle $E$. For each $p \in (1,\infty)$ we consider the closed $\mathrm{L}^p$-realization $\mathcal{D}_{E,p}$ of the Dolbeault-Dirac operator $\mathcal{D}_{E}$ on the Banach space $\mathrm{L}^p(Ω^{0,\bullet}(M,E))$. We prove that $\mathcal{D}_{E,p}$ is bisectorial and admits a bounded $\mathrm{H}^\infty$ functional calculus.
